• Drag one finger = move the pointer
• Tap = left click
• Tap with two fingers = right click
• Drag two fingers up/down = scroll
• Tap, then touch and drag = drag and drop
• Spread / pinch two fingers = zoom

• Tap = click there
• Hold half a second, then let go = right click
• Drag one finger = drag and drop
• Spread / pinch two fingers = zoom
• Drag two fingers = move the zoomed picture
